summary: Fixed the state carry-over defect where a `check` restart launched from a `paused` LLM-fix session opened the deploy panel with 'Use global proxy' UNCHECKED, so the restart registered with `build_args: {}` while the deploy that created the session had recorded the proxy args. Justification is G20's existing precedent (a resumed path replays the options it was created with; the gateway already re-adds `use_global_proxy` for a refused Retry) — a `check` restart is the same situation. Minimal change in three layers: (1) proxy_service gains PROXY_ENV_KEYS + build_args_carry_global_proxy(); (2) pre_deploy_registry.add_session stores `use_global_proxy`, and generation_jobs._llm_fix_handoff derives it from the FAILED instance's registry `build_args` (read BEFORE the add-then-delete removes the entry that carries it) and stores it on the paused session; (3) UsersPage's `check` handler passes the session's value to DeployForm via `preselectedUseGlobalProxy`, which seeds it synchronously on open (before the first await, avoiding the hydration window the label pin had) and re-asserts it at submit time from that same source unless the operator toggled the box — the same shape as the label fix. Rebuilt both images (gateway sha256:954b6acf..., dashboard sha256:637a26f9...) and proved it behaviourally on the dashboard: proxycarry/probe-slow/0 one-shot deploy with docker-compose.yml + proxy ticked, cancelled while building -> failed; LLM based fix -> check; the panel opened CHECKED (rAF trace: checked:true from the first frame, t=341 ms, never changed); confirm -> the restart's registry entry carries the four proxy build args identical to the original deploy's, and request.label = the session's own label. 462 passed in tests/test_unit.py (11 new). No contamination: every audit_log/generation_jobs row above the recorded baseline is attributable to this run.

Fix the layer that loses the state: proxy_service.PROXY_ENV_KEYS + build_args_carry_global_proxy() recognise the proxy's four build args; pre_deploy_registry.add_session persists `use_global_proxy`; generation_jobs._instance_used_global_proxy reads the failed instance's registry build_args (before the handoff's delete) and _llm_fix_handoff stores it on the paused session; UsersPage.check sets preselectedUseGlobalProxy from the session; DeployForm seeds it synchronously at open and re-asserts at submit from one shared predicate, skipping the re-assert if the operator toggled the box. 11 unit tests added (backend detection + persistence + panel wiring guards).
